Start your websiteMy website — open your editorWedding websites · edit on your phoneEnvelope wedding websites that open like a real invitationYour guests tap a sealed envelope, it opens, and your wedding website appears: your story, the details and RSVP. You edit everything from your phone.Tap to openBlush Garden Rose: blush pink envelope with a ribbon bow, peonies, garden roses and gold arched frames.Blush Garden RoseOlive & IvoryMediterranean LemonDusty Blue & ChampagneVintage Airmail Love LetterArt Deco Black-TieBurgundy Velvet AutumnWinter EvergreenLavender ProvenceTuscan VineyardBoho Pampas TerracottaTropical DestinationEnchanted Forest StorybookIvory Lace & Pearls+7 moreOpen the invitationSee all designsRSVP built inAdd to calendarNo Canva neededOnline until 12 months after your wedding dateWhat is BKE Studio?BKE Studio is a wedding website you buy once on Etsy. Your guests tap a sealed envelope that opens into your site: Home, Our Story, Details and RSVP. You edit names, date, venue, schedule, photos and RSVP questions from your phone, preview, and publish. Guest replies appear in your private panel and can be downloaded as a CSV. No Canva account or app is needed, and your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date.The first momentHow the opening worksSealedOpeningYour websiteYour link opens on a sealed envelope with your names, the way a paper invitation arrives.Guests tap it. The envelope opens in the order of its design: a bow slides, a seal lifts, a card rises.The card becomes your home page. From there guests read your story, the details and reply.Every design opens in its own way. Guests can skip the animation, and on a phone set to reduce motion a tap goes straight to the home page.After the envelopeFour pages your guests will actually useHomeYour names, date and venueOur StoryThree photos with captionsDetailsSchedule, venue and dress codeRSVPReplies and your own questionsDesigned for phone screensMade to edit from your phoneNo Canva, no app. Open your private edit link and change what you need, between other plans.Names, date and time, venue and map link, the order of the day (up to 10 rows)5 photos, each cropped to its frame on your phoneYour story, questions and answers (up to 12), dress code, registry and travel linksPreview every page before you publish; changes save on their ownAfter publishing: 3 name and date changes in total; typo fixes and moving the date by up to 7 days are free.Everything you can editRSVP built inRSVPs without the spreadsheet chaosComing9Not coming1Replies5Example totals from the demo panel (fictional guests)Guests reply on your website: coming or not, party size and a note. No account for them.Up to 3 questions of your own, such as a meal choiceA reply-by date; the form closes on its own after itEvery reply and the totals in your panel, plus a CSV downloadMore about RSVPFrom Etsy to your guestsHow it works1Try a design on your phoneOpen the live demo and tap the envelope, exactly as your guests will.2Buy it on EtsyOne payment. Your download holds the link to start your website.3Edit, preview, publishAdd your names, date, venue, photos and RSVP questions in your private panel.4Share your linkSend it by text or email, or print the QR code. Replies arrive in your panel.See every stepDesignsChoose the envelope your guests will openBlush Garden RoseBlush pink envelope with a ribbon bow, peonies, garden roses and gold arched frames.Live seal, cream roses, eucalyptus and instant-photo cards.Live demo: Dusty Blue & ChampagneVintage Airmail Love LetterRed and navy striped airmail envelope with a burgundy wax seal, postage stamps, Pampas TerracottaTropical DestinationTravel wallet with a leather strap and a brass snap, plumeria, monstera, hibiscus and luggage-tag frames.Live demo: Tropical DestinationEnchanted Forest with a pearl brooch, white garden roses, pearl strands and carved oval frames.Live demo: Ivory Lace & PearlsSee all designsOne design. One payment on Etsy.No subscription and nothing to renew: your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date.Envelope opening and four pagesEditing panel and online RSVPAdd to calendar and QR codeSee pricingQuestions couples ask firstWhat do I get after buying on Etsy?You get a short PDF with the link to start your website. There you enter your Etsy order number, your email and your first names, choose your web address, and your draft website is created in the design you bought. Then you edit it in your private panel. What is included.Do I need Canva or an app?No. You edit your website in a private panel that opens in your phone's browser, so there is no Canva account and no app to install. The panel is designed for phone screens and also works on a computer. You can preview every page before you publish. See the features.Can we change our names or date after publishing?Yes, within a limit. After you publish, you get 3 changes in total to your names, monogram and date; several at once count as one. Free any time: small typo fixes (up to 2 letters in a name), adding a surname, and moving the date up to 7 days. Everything else (time, venue, schedule, story, photos, details and replies) you can change as often as you like. Before you publish, you can change everything freely. See how it works.How do guests reply?Guests reply on the RSVP page of your website. They enter their name, whether they are coming, how many people are in their party, an optional message and your own questions. The form closes on its own after your reply-by date. See RSVP features.How long is our website online?Your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date, so guests can come back to it after the day. What happens after that: [EXTENSION POLICY]. You can also take it offline yourself at any time from the panel. Start your websiteMy website — open your editorWedding websites · edit on your phoneEnvelope wedding websites that open like a real invitationYour guests tap a sealed envelope, it opens, and your wedding website appears: your story, the details and RSVP. You edit everything from your phone.Tap to openBlush Garden Rose: blush pink envelope with a ribbon bow, peonies, garden roses and gold arched frames.Blush Garden RoseOlive & IvoryMediterranean LemonDusty Blue & ChampagneVintage Airmail Love LetterArt Deco Black-TieBurgundy Velvet AutumnWinter EvergreenLavender ProvenceTuscan VineyardBoho Pampas TerracottaTropical DestinationEnchanted Forest StorybookIvory Lace & Pearls+7 moreOpen the invitationSee all designsRSVP built inAdd to calendarNo Canva neededOnline until 12 months after your wedding dateWhat is BKE Studio?BKE Studio is a wedding website you buy once on Etsy. Your guests tap a sealed envelope that opens into your site: Home, Our Story, Details and RSVP. You edit names, date, venue, schedule, photos and RSVP questions from your phone, preview, and publish. Guest replies appear in your private panel and can be downloaded as a CSV. No Canva account or app is needed, and your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date.The first momentHow the opening worksSealedOpeningYour websiteYour link opens on a sealed envelope with your names, the way a paper invitation arrives.Guests tap it. The envelope opens in the order of its design: a bow slides, a seal lifts, a card rises.The card becomes your home page. From there guests read your story, the details and reply.Every design opens in its own way. Guests can skip the animation, and on a phone set to reduce motion a tap goes straight to the home page.After the envelopeFour pages your guests will actually useHomeYour names, date and venueOur StoryThree photos with captionsDetailsSchedule, venue and dress codeRSVPReplies and your own questionsDesigned for phone screensMade to edit from your phoneNo Canva, no app. Open your private edit link and change what you need, between other plans.Names, date and time, venue and map link, the order of the day (up to 10 rows)5 photos, each cropped to its frame on your phoneYour story, questions and answers (up to 12), dress code, registry and travel linksPreview every page before you publish; changes save on their ownAfter publishing: 3 name and date changes in total; typo fixes and moving the date by up to 7 days are free.Everything you can editRSVP built inRSVPs without the spreadsheet chaosComing9Not coming1Replies5Example totals from the demo panel (fictional guests)Guests reply on your website: coming or not, party size and a note. No account for them.Up to 3 questions of your own, such as a meal choiceA reply-by date; the form closes on its own after itEvery reply and the totals in your panel, plus a CSV downloadMore about RSVPFrom Etsy to your guestsHow it works1Try a design on your phoneOpen the live demo and tap the envelope, exactly as your guests will.2Buy it on EtsyOne payment. Your download holds the link to start your website.3Edit, preview, publishAdd your names, date, venue, photos and RSVP questions in your private panel.4Share your linkSend it by text or email, or print the QR code. Replies arrive in your panel.See every stepDesignsChoose the envelope your guests will openBlush Garden RoseBlush pink envelope with a ribbon bow, peonies, garden roses and gold arched frames.Live Start your websiteMy website — open your editorWedding websites · edit on your phoneEnvelope wedding websites that open like a real invitationYour guests tap a sealed envelope, it opens, and your wedding website appears: your story, the details and RSVP. You edit everything from your phone.Tap to openBlush Garden Rose: blush pink envelope with a ribbon bow, peonies, garden roses and gold arched frames.Blush Garden RoseOlive & IvoryMediterranean LemonDusty Blue & ChampagneVintage Airmail Love LetterArt Deco Black-TieBurgundy Velvet AutumnWinter EvergreenLavender ProvenceTuscan VineyardBoho Pampas TerracottaTropical DestinationEnchanted Forest StorybookIvory Lace & Pearls+7 moreOpen the invitationSee all designsRSVP built inAdd to calendarNo Canva neededOnline until 12 months after your wedding dateWhat is BKE Studio?BKE Studio is a wedding website you buy once on Etsy. Your guests tap a sealed envelope that opens into your site: Home, Our Story, Details and RSVP. You edit names, date, venue, schedule, photos and RSVP questions from your phone, preview, and publish. Guest replies appear in your private panel and can be downloaded as a CSV. No Canva account or app is needed, and your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date.The first momentHow the opening worksSealedOpeningYour websiteYour link opens on a sealed envelope with your names, the way a paper invitation arrives.Guests tap it. The envelope opens in the order of its design: a bow slides, a seal lifts, a card rises.The card becomes your home page. From there guests read your story, the details and reply.Every design opens in its own way. Your guests tap a sealed envelope that opens into your site: Home, Our Story, Details and RSVP. You edit names, date, venue, schedule, photos and RSVP questions from your phone, preview, and publish. Guest replies appear in your private panel and can be downloaded as a CSV. There you enter your Etsy order number, your email and your first names, choose your web address, and your draft website is created in the design you bought. Then you edit it in your private panel. What is included.Do I need Canva or an app?No. You edit your website in a private panel that opens in your phone's browser, so there is no Canva account and no app to install. The panel is designed for phone screens and also works on a computer. You can preview every page before you publish. See the features.Can we change our names or date after publishing?Yes, within a limit. After you publish, you get 3 changes in total to your names, monogram and date; several at once count as one. Free any time: small typo fixes (up to 2 letters in a name), adding a surname, and moving the date up to 7 days. Everything else (time, venue, schedule, story, photos, details and replies) you can change as often as you like. Before you publish, you can change everything freely. See how it works.How do guests reply?Guests reply on the RSVP page of your website. They enter their name, whether they are coming, how many people are in their party, an optional message and your own questions. The form closes on its own after your reply-by date. See RSVP features.How long is our website online?Your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date, so guests can come back to it after the day. What happens after that: [EXTENSION POLICY]. You can also take it offline yourself at any time from the panel. Your guests tap a sealed envelope that opens into your site: Home, Our Story, Details and RSVP. You edit names, date, venue, schedule, photos and RSVP questions from your phone, preview, and publish. Guest replies appear in your private panel and can be downloaded as a CSV. There you enter your Etsy order number, your email and your first names, choose your web address, and your draft website is created in the design you bought. Then you edit it in your private panel. What is included.Do I need Canva or an app?No. You edit your website in a private panel that opens in your phone's browser, so there is no Canva account and no app to install. The panel is designed for phone screens and also works on a computer. You can preview every page before you publish. See the features.Can we change our names or date after publishing?Yes, within a limit. After you publish, you get 3 changes in total to your names, monogram and date; several at once count as one. Free any time: small typo fixes (up to 2 letters in a name), adding a surname, and moving the date up to 7 days. Everything else (time, venue, schedule, story, photos, details and replies) you can change as often as you like. Before you publish, you can change everything freely. See how it works.How do guests reply?Guests reply on the RSVP page of your website. They enter their name, whether they are coming, how many people are in their party, an optional message and your own questions. The form closes on its own after your reply-by date. See RSVP features.How long is our website online?Your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date, so guests can come back to it after the day. What happens after that: [EXTENSION POLICY]. You can also take it offline yourself at any time from the panel. Your guests tap a sealed envelope that opens into your site: Home, Our Story, Details and RSVP. You edit names, date, venue, schedule, photos and RSVP questions from your phone, preview, and publish. Guest replies appear in your private panel and can be downloaded as a CSV. There you enter your Etsy order number, your email and your first names, choose your web address, and your draft website is created in the design you bought. Then you edit it in your private panel. What is included.Do I need Canva or an app?No. You edit your website in a private panel that opens in your phone's browser, so there is no Canva account and no app to install. The panel is designed for phone screens and also works on a computer. You can preview every page before you publish. See the features.Can we change our names or date after publishing?Yes, within a limit. After you publish, you get 3 changes in total to your names, monogram and date; several at once count as one. Free any time: small typo fixes (up to 2 letters in a name), adding a surname, and moving the date up to 7 days. Everything else (time, venue, schedule, story, photos, details and replies) you can change as often as you like. Before you publish, you can change everything freely. See how it works.How do guests reply?Guests reply on the RSVP page of your website. They enter their name, whether they are coming, how many people are in their party, an optional message and your own questions. The form closes on its own after your reply-by date. See RSVP features.How long is our website online?Your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date, so guests can come back to it after the day. What happens after that: [EXTENSION POLICY]. You can also take it offline yourself at any time from the panel. Your guests tap a sealed envelope that opens into your site: Home, Our Story, Details and RSVP. You edit names, date, venue, schedule, photos and RSVP questions from your phone, preview, and publish. Guest replies appear in your private panel and can be downloaded as a CSV. There you enter your Etsy order number, your email and your first names, choose your web address, and your draft website is created in the design you bought. Then you edit it in your private panel. What is included.Do I need Canva or an app?No. You edit your website in a private panel that opens in your phone's browser, so there is no Canva account and no app to install. The panel is designed for phone screens and also works on a computer. You can preview every page before you publish. See the features.Can we change our names or date after publishing?Yes, within a limit. After you publish, you get 3 changes in total to your names, monogram and date; several at once count as one. Free any time: small typo fixes (up to 2 letters in a name), adding a surname, and moving the date up to 7 days. Everything else (time, venue, schedule, story, photos, details and replies) you can change as often as you like. Before you publish, you can change everything freely. See how it works.How do guests reply?Guests reply on the RSVP page of your website. They enter their name, whether they are coming, how many people are in their party, an optional message and your own questions. The form closes on its own after your reply-by date. See RSVP features.How long is our website online?Your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date, so guests can come back to it after the day. What happens after that: [EXTENSION POLICY]. You can also take it offline yourself at any time from the panel. Start your websiteMy website — open your editorWedding websites · edit on your phoneEnvelope wedding websites that open like a real invitationYour guests tap a sealed envelope, it opens, and your wedding website appears: your story, the details and RSVP. You edit everything from your phone.Tap to openBlush Garden Rose: blush pink envelope with a ribbon bow, peonies, garden roses and gold arched frames.Blush Garden RoseOlive & IvoryMediterranean LemonDusty Blue & ChampagneVintage Airmail Love LetterArt Deco Black-TieBurgundy Velvet AutumnWinter EvergreenLavender ProvenceTuscan VineyardBoho Pampas TerracottaTropical DestinationEnchanted Forest StorybookIvory Lace & Pearls+7 moreOpen the invitationSee all designsRSVP built inAdd to calendarNo Canva neededOnline until 12 months after your wedding dateWhat is BKE Studio?BKE Studio is a wedding website you buy once on Etsy. Your guests tap a sealed envelope that opens into your site: Home, Our Story, Details and RSVP. You edit names, date, venue, schedule, photos and RSVP questions from your phone, preview, and publish. Guest replies appear in your private panel and can be downloaded as a CSV. No Canva account or app is needed, and your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date.The first momentHow the opening worksSealedOpeningYour websiteYour link opens on a sealed envelope with your names, the way a paper invitation arrives.Guests tap it. The envelope opens in the order of its design: a bow slides, a seal lifts, a card rises.The card becomes your home page. From there guests read your story, the details and reply.Every design opens in its own way. Guests can skip the animation, and on a phone set to reduce motion a tap goes straight to the home page.After the envelopeFour pages your guests will actually useHomeYour names, date and venueOur StoryThree photos with captionsDetailsSchedule, venue and dress codeRSVPReplies and your own questionsDesigned for phone screensMade to edit from your phoneNo Canva, no app. Open your private edit link and change what you need, between other plans.Names, date and time, venue and map link, the order of the day (up to 10 rows)5 photos, each cropped to its frame on your phoneYour story, questions and answers (up to 12), dress code, registry and travel linksPreview every page before you publish; changes save on their ownAfter publishing: 3 name and date changes in total; typo fixes and moving the date by up to 7 days are free.Everything you can editRSVP built inRSVPs without the spreadsheet chaosComing9Not coming1Replies5Example totals from the demo panel (fictional guests)Guests reply on your website: coming or not, party size and a note. No account for them.Up to 3 questions of your own, such as a meal choiceA reply-by date; the form closes on its own after itEvery reply and the totals in your panel, plus a CSV downloadMore about RSVPFrom Etsy to your guestsHow it works1Try a design on your phoneOpen the live demo and tap the envelope, exactly as your guests will.2Buy it on EtsyOne payment. Your download holds the link to start your website.3Edit, preview, publishAdd your names, date, venue, photos and RSVP questions in your private panel.4Share your linkSend it by text or email, or print the QR code. Replies arrive in your panel.See every stepDesignsChoose the envelope your guests will openBlush Garden RoseBlush pink envelope with a ribbon bow, peonies, garden roses and gold arched frames.Live demo: Blush Garden RoseOlive & IvoryOlive green envelope with an ivory lace edge, a wax seal with your initials and olive branches.Live demo: Olive & IvoryMediterranean LemonWhite envelope with a seal, cream roses, eucalyptus and instant-photo cards.Live demo: Dusty Blue & ChampagneVintage Airmail Love LetterRed and navy striped airmail envelope with a burgundy wax seal, postage stamps, demo: Art Deco Black-TieBurgundy Velvet AutumnIvory envelope wrapped in burgundy velvet ribbon, dahlias, blackberries, copper autumn leaves and oval gold frames.Live demo: Burgundy Velvet AutumnWinter EvergreenForest green envelope with a snowy deckle edge, a pine-and-berry bundle, pine cones and frosted window frames.Live demo: Winter EvergreenLavender ProvenceCream linen pouch tied with jute twine and a lavender bundle, pressed lavender, daisies and pressed-flower cards.Live demo: Lavender ProvenceTuscan VineyardKraft envelope tied with twine, a cork and olive leaves, grape clusters, vine leaves and wine-label frames.Live demo: Tuscan VineyardBoho Pampas TerracottaTerracotta arch envelope tied with pampas and a palm spear, dried roses and arch frames on sunlit sand.Live demo: Boho Pampas TerracottaTropical DestinationTravel wallet with a leather strap and a brass snap, plumeria, monstera, hibiscus and luggage-tag frames.Live demo: Tropical DestinationEnchanted Forest StorybookMoss-green storybook with a brass clasp, ferns, toadstools, fireflies and photo-cornered storybook pages.Live demo: Enchanted Forest StorybookIvory Lace & PearlsLace-covered ivory gatefold with a pearl brooch, white garden roses, pearl strands and carved oval frames.Live demo: Ivory Lace & PearlsSee all designsOne design. One payment on Etsy.No subscription and nothing to renew: your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date.Envelope opening and four pagesEditing panel and online RSVPAdd to calendar and QR codeSee pricingQuestions couples ask firstWhat do I get after buying on Etsy?You get a short PDF with the link to start your website. There you enter your Etsy order number, your email and your first names, choose your web address, and your draft website is created in the design you bought. Then you edit it in your private panel. What is included.Do I need Canva or an app?No. You edit your website in a private panel that opens in your phone's browser, so there is no Canva account and no app to install. The panel is designed for phone screens and also works on a computer. You can preview every page before you publish. See the features.Can we change our names or date after publishing?Yes, within a limit. After you publish, you get 3 changes in total to your names, monogram and date; several at once count as one. Free any time: small typo fixes (up to 2 letters in a name), adding a surname, and moving the date up to 7 days. Everything else (time, venue, schedule, story, photos, details and replies) you can change as often as you like. Before you publish, you can change everything freely. See how it works.How do guests reply?Guests reply on the RSVP page of your website. They enter their name, whether they are coming, how many people are in their party, an optional message and your own questions. The form closes on its own after your reply-by date. See RSVP features.How long is our website online?Your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date, so guests can come back to it after the day. What happens after that: [EXTENSION POLICY]. You can also take it offline yourself at any time from the panel. Your guests tap a sealed envelope that opens into your site: Home, Our Story, Details and RSVP. You edit names, date, venue, schedule, photos and RSVP questions from your phone, preview, and publish. Guest replies appear in your private panel and can be downloaded as a CSV. There you enter your Etsy order number, your email and your first names, choose your web address, and your draft website is created in the design you bought. Then you edit it in your private panel. What is included.Do I need Canva or an app?No. You edit your website in a private panel that opens in your phone's browser, so there is no Canva account and no app to install. The panel is designed for phone screens and also works on a computer. You can preview every page before you publish. See the features.Can we change our names or date after publishing?Yes, within a limit. After you publish, you get 3 changes in total to your names, monogram and date; several at once count as one. Free any time: small typo fixes (up to 2 letters in a name), adding a surname, and moving the date up to 7 days. Everything else (time, venue, schedule, story, photos, details and replies) you can change as often as you like. Before you publish, you can change everything freely. See how it works.How do guests reply?Guests reply on the RSVP page of your website. They enter their name, whether they are coming, how many people are in their party, an optional message and your own questions. The form closes on its own after your reply-by date. See RSVP features.How long is our website online?Your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date, so guests can come back to it after the day. What happens after that: [EXTENSION POLICY]. You can also take it offline yourself at any time from the panel. Start your websiteMy website — open your editorWedding websites · edit on your phoneEnvelope wedding websites that open like a real invitationYour guests tap a sealed envelope, it opens, and your wedding website appears: your story, the details and RSVP. You edit everything from your phone.Tap to openBlush Garden Rose: blush pink envelope with a ribbon bow, peonies, garden roses and gold arched frames.Blush Garden RoseOlive & IvoryMediterranean LemonDusty Blue & ChampagneVintage Airmail Love LetterArt Deco Black-TieBurgundy Velvet AutumnWinter EvergreenLavender ProvenceTuscan VineyardBoho Pampas TerracottaTropical DestinationEnchanted Forest StorybookIvory Lace & Pearls+7 moreOpen the invitationSee all designsRSVP built inAdd to calendarNo Canva neededOnline until 12 months after your wedding dateWhat is BKE Studio?BKE Studio is a wedding website you buy once on Etsy. Your guests tap a sealed envelope that opens into your site: Home, Our Story, Details and RSVP. You edit names, date, venue, schedule, photos and RSVP questions from your phone, preview, and publish. Guest replies appear in your private panel and can be downloaded as a CSV. No Canva account or app is needed, and your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date.The first momentHow the opening worksSealedOpeningYour websiteYour link opens on a sealed envelope with your names, the way a paper invitation arrives.Guests tap it. The envelope opens in the order of its design: a bow slides, a seal lifts, a card rises.The card becomes your home page. From there guests read your story, the details and reply.Every design opens in its own way. Guests can skip the animation, and on a phone set to reduce motion a tap goes straight to the home page.After the envelopeFour pages your guests will actually useHomeYour names, date and venueOur StoryThree photos with captionsDetailsSchedule, venue and dress codeRSVPReplies and your own questionsDesigned for phone screensMade to edit from your phoneNo Canva, no app. Open your private edit link and change what you need, between other plans.Names, date and time, venue and map link, the order of the day (up to 10 rows)5 photos, each cropped to its frame on your phoneYour story, questions and answers (up to 12), dress code, registry and travel linksPreview every page before you publish; changes save on their ownAfter publishing: 3 name and date changes in total; typo fixes and moving the date by up to 7 days are free.Everything you can editRSVP built inRSVPs without the spreadsheet chaosComing9Not coming1Replies5Example totals from the demo panel (fictional guests)Guests reply on your website: coming or not, party size and a note. No account for them.Up to 3 questions of your own, such as a meal choiceA reply-by date; the form closes on its own after itEvery reply and the totals in your panel, plus a CSV downloadMore about RSVPFrom Etsy to your guestsHow it works1Try a design on your phoneOpen the live demo and tap the envelope, exactly as your guests will.2Buy it on EtsyOne payment. Your download holds the link to start your website.3Edit, preview, publishAdd your names, date, venue, photos and RSVP questions in your private panel.4Share your linkSend it by text or email, or print the QR code. Replies arrive in your panel.See every stepDesignsChoose the envelope your guests will openBlush Garden RoseBlush pink envelope with a ribbon bow, peonies, garden roses and gold arched frames.Live demo: Blush Garden RoseOlive & IvoryOlive green envelope with an ivory lace edge, a wax seal with your initials and olive branches.Live demo: Olive & IvoryMediterranean LemonWhite envelope with a seal, cream roses, eucalyptus and instant-photo cards.Live demo: Dusty Blue & ChampagneVintage Airmail Love LetterRed and navy striped airmail envelope with a burgundy wax seal, postage stamps, demo: Art Deco Black-TieBurgundy Velvet AutumnIvory envelope wrapped in burgundy velvet ribbon, dahlias, blackberries, copper autumn leaves and oval gold frames.Live demo: Burgundy Velvet AutumnWinter EvergreenForest green envelope with a snowy deckle edge, a pine-and-berry bundle, pine cones and frosted window frames.Live demo: Winter EvergreenLavender ProvenceCream linen pouch tied with jute twine and a lavender bundle, pressed lavender, daisies and pressed-flower cards.Live demo: Lavender ProvenceTuscan VineyardKraft envelope tied with twine, a cork and olive leaves, grape clusters, vine leaves and wine-label frames.Live demo: Tuscan VineyardBoho Pampas TerracottaTerracotta arch envelope tied with pampas and a palm spear, dried roses and arch frames on sunlit sand.Live demo: Boho Pampas TerracottaTropical DestinationTravel wallet with a leather strap and a brass snap, plumeria, monstera, hibiscus and luggage-tag frames.Live demo: Tropical DestinationEnchanted Forest StorybookMoss-green storybook with a brass clasp, ferns, toadstools, fireflies and photo-cornered storybook pages.Live demo: Enchanted Forest StorybookIvory Lace & PearlsLace-covered ivory gatefold with a pearl brooch, white garden roses, pearl strands and carved oval frames.Live demo: Ivory Lace & PearlsSee all designsOne design. One payment on Etsy.No subscription and nothing to renew: your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date.Envelope opening and four pagesEditing panel and online RSVPAdd to calendar and QR codeSee pricingQuestions couples ask firstWhat do I get after buying on Etsy?You get a short PDF with the link to start your website. There you enter your Etsy order number, your email and your first names, choose your web address, and your draft website is created in the design you bought. Then you edit it in your private panel. What is included.Do I need Canva or an app?No. You edit your website in a private panel that opens in your phone's browser, so there is no Canva account and no app to install. The panel is designed for phone screens and also works on a computer. You can preview every page before you publish. See the features.Can we change our names or date after publishing?Yes, within a limit. After you publish, you get 3 changes in total to your names, monogram and date; several at once count as one. Free any time: small typo fixes (up to 2 letters in a name), adding a surname, and moving the date up to 7 days. Everything else (time, venue, schedule, story, photos, details and replies) you can change as often as you like. Before you publish, you can change everything freely. See how it works.How do guests reply?Guests reply on the RSVP page of your website. They enter their name, whether they are coming, how many people are in their party, an optional message and your own questions. The form closes on its own after your reply-by date. See RSVP features.How long is our website online?Your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date, so guests can come back to it after the day. What happens after that: [EXTENSION POLICY]. You can also take it offline yourself at any time from the panel. Your guests tap a sealed envelope that opens into your site: Home, Our Story, Details and RSVP. You edit names, date, venue, schedule, photos and RSVP questions from your phone, preview, and publish. Guest replies appear in your private panel and can be downloaded as a CSV. There you enter your Etsy order number, your email and your first names, choose your web address, and your draft website is created in the design you bought. Then you edit it in your private panel. What is included.Do I need Canva or an app?No. You edit your website in a private panel that opens in your phone's browser, so there is no Canva account and no app to install. The panel is designed for phone screens and also works on a computer. You can preview every page before you publish. See the features.Can we change our names or date after publishing?Yes, within a limit. After you publish, you get 3 changes in total to your names, monogram and date; several at once count as one. Free any time: small typo fixes (up to 2 letters in a name), adding a surname, and moving the date up to 7 days. Everything else (time, venue, schedule, story, photos, details and replies) you can change as often as you like. Before you publish, you can change everything freely. See how it works.How do guests reply?Guests reply on the RSVP page of your website. They enter their name, whether they are coming, how many people are in their party, an optional message and your own questions. The form closes on its own after your reply-by date. See RSVP features.How long is our website online?Your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date, so guests can come back to it after the day. What happens after that: [EXTENSION POLICY]. You can also take it offline yourself at any time from the panel.
